display_name: Ivabradine for chronic HFrEF — demonstration criteria
payer_display: Simulated Demonstration Plan (not a real insurer)
disclaimer: SIMULATED POLICY. Written for CardioFlow demonstration only. Loosely modeled on the general shape of published ivabradine indication criteria; it does not reproduce, represent, or predict any real insurer's coverage policy and must not be used for clinical or coverage decisions.
indication_text: Stable, symptomatic chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction in sinus rhythm with elevated resting heart rate despite beta-blocker optimization.

requirements.title: Requested medication documented
requirements.policy_text: Encounter documents a decided plan to start ivabradine.

requirements.title: Chronic HFrEF diagnosis
requirements.policy_text: Diagnosis of chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.

requirements.title: LVEF ≤ 35% within 12 months
requirements.policy_text: Left ventricular ejection fraction of 35% or less, measured within 365 days before the encounter.

requirements.title: NYHA class II–III
requirements.policy_text: Symptomatic heart failure, NYHA functional class II or III.

requirements.title: Sinus rhythm documented
requirements.policy_text: Sinus rhythm documented by ECG or monitor at this encounter; no atrial fibrillation.

requirements.title: Resting heart rate ≥ 70 bpm
requirements.policy_text: Resting heart rate of 70 beats per minute or higher.

requirements.title: Beta-blocker optimized
requirements.policy_text: On maximally tolerated beta-blocker dose, or beta-blocker contraindicated or not tolerated.

requirements.title: No hypotension
requirements.policy_text: Blood pressure at or above 90/50 mmHg.
